moneyCash.title: Money in & out
moneyCash.sub: Every taka that came in or went out, by account.
moneyCash.off: Recording in the cashbook is switched off in the settings. You can still see what is here.
moneyCash.readOnly: You can see the cashbook. Recording money needs the permission to record cash.

month.note: Transfers between your own accounts are not counted.

forecast.title: Next {days} days
forecast.sub: A calculation, not a promise: today's balance, the cash couriers hold arriving after the payout days, and the fixed costs due.
forecast.short: The balance goes below zero while paying the fixed costs.

all.title: All movements
all.sub: Balance = that account after the movement. Newest first.

err.forbidden: You do not have permission for this.
err.PIN_LOCKED: Too many wrong PINs. Wait a while and try again.
err.PIN_NOT_SET: The owner has not set a PIN yet (Closes page).
err.CASH_OFF: Recording in the cashbook is switched off.
err.INVALID_INPUT: Check the account, the amount and the day.
err.other: It could not be saved. Try again.

match.title: Match courier account
match.sub: One click checks every parcel: COD, delivery charge, return charge and payouts.
match.charge: Courier charged {a} delivery fee, our rate is {b}
match.cash: Marked delivered, but {a} cash is not in the statement
